name: Zuplo
summary: Zuplo is a gateway for APIs and AI traffic, with per-key rate limits, API key, JWT and OAuth authentication, a developer portal and request analytics. The Free plan is listed at $0 with 100,000 requests a month. Builder is $25 a month billed monthly, and Enterprise starts from $1,000 a month on an annual contract. The pricing page does not name its currency.

facts.text: The homepage describes Zuplo as the unified gateway for APIs and AI.
The homepage says API keys, JWT and OAuth tokens can be used with per-key rate limits, and that every call is authenticated as a verified identity.
The pricing page says the Developer Portal is hosted on the customer's own domain and is included in every plan.
The pricing page lists 1 day of analytics on Free, 7 days on Builder and 30 days on Enterprise, with custom options for longer periods.
The pricing page shows dollar signs and does not name a currency.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100,000 requests a month, 2 developer seats, 5 environments and 1 day of analytics.

plans.name: Builder
plans.notes: 100,000 requests included, 2 custom domains, 10 environments, 2 developer seats and 7 days of analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.unit: from, per month on an annual contract
plans.notes: Custom limits, volume discounts above 1 million requests a month and 30 days of analytics.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page does not name its currency. The figures use the dollar sign.
The Builder request allowance and the charge for extra requests are described in ways that do not match on the page, so check the current terms before budgeting.
